name: monk
description: Stock research for AI assistants: chart and scan US stocks, ETFs and futures, and read SEC filings, insider trades, company financials and news. Never trades or reaches a brokerage.

interface.longDescription: Monk.trade runs stock research across actively traded US stocks from a plain question, and each filing match links to the SEC filing or Form 4 behind it. Find open-market buying by officers and directors, 13D stakes crossing 5% or switching from a 13G, 8-K items and late 10-K and 10-Q notices, then check reported revenue, earnings, share counts and news. You can also chart US stocks, ETFs and futures, use it as a stock screener on price and volume, and save the queries you reuse. Monk.trade never trades or reaches a brokerage. Queries are written in MonkQL.
defaultPrompt: Which stocks had two or more officers or directors buy shares on the open market in the last month, and at what prices?
Find 13D stakes that crossed 5% or switched from a 13G this quarter, naming the holder.
Which stocks fell this week after an earnings 8-K, with latest reported revenue up over 20% from a year ago?
